quoted_tweet.text:
Using Grok, with the prompt:  “Who Pushed/Made It Viral Online?

It started organically from the network but was turbocharged by pro-Marcos digital armies:

•  Initial spark (official/neutral): TV5/News5 uploaded the first clips to their YouTube and X (@News5PH) within hours of the live broadcast on Nov 16 afternoon/evening. Their posts (e.g., “SAGUTAN NINA CASTRO AT TIQUIA” and “CASTRO VS. TIQUIA: NASAAN SI GUTEZA?”) got tens of thousands of views/reposts quickly — standard for a major network.

•  Pro-Marcos troll farms & influencers took over: The “savage Claire owned DDS” narrative dominated. Big pro-admin pages (e.g., “31 Million Movement” on FB with posts like “SAVAGE WINNER: Claire Castro Just Ended the Debate 🔥”), Maharlika-type accounts, and coordinated X users flooded with edited clips captioned “Wasak si Tiquia!”, “Ante Kler strikes again!”, and anti-DDS slurs. These got the highest engagement (hundreds of thousands of likes/shares).

•  Opposition/DDS side reacted but slower/weaker: Pro-Duterte pages (SMNI affiliates, DDS vloggers) shared counter-clips focusing on Castro’s “unprofessionalism” and Tiquia’s post-debate statement (“Spoxs should never lose their cool”). But volume-wise, they were drowned out — pro-Marcos push was more organized and meme-heavy.

•  Cross-platform snowball: From X/YouTube → FB groups → TikTok stitches → Reddit threads (multiple posts with 500-700+ upvotes calling it “bardagulan of the year”).

In short: News5 lit the match, but pro-Marcos online machinery (trolls, fan pages, influencers) poured the gasoline, making the “Claire slayed” version the dominant viral take. Classic asymmetric info war — the side that clips better and memes faster “wins” the narrative online.”

Proof there are organized trolls on the admin side and they are prepared to amplify their line and push their narrative as the dominant one.

And there, they fell into the trap carefully framed n positioned! Now I have proofs of how their funnel operates.

data.text:
"enhyen donates $68,177 for philippine flood relief efforts" 🥹🥹

global k-pop powerhouse enhypen, in partnership with their agency belift lab, announced a donation of 100 million won ($68,177) to support flood relief efforts in the philippines.

'we became aware of the recent severe flooding affecting many communities across the philippines, a country that has long been close to our hearts,' enhypen said through a press release.

'we wanted to offer our support, even in a small way, and sincerely hope the contributions will be used to help those in need and assist in the ongoing recovery efforts. our hearts are with the local community and fans during this challenging time,' the group added.

belift lab said the donation aims to 'provide relief to residents affected by the recent severe flooding, helping to aid recovery initiatives and community rebuilding efforts.'

'the philippines is where enhypen held their first stadium concert in southeast asia, and it remains a place of deep significance to both the group and our team. we hope our donation will provide meaningful help to those affected by the recent floods,' the agency said.

data.text:
To all my moots and friends who are flying for PeBaCa con in Manila this weekend and it’s their first time in Manila - pls note of the following:

1) if you’re staying far from the venue, pls plan your travel time.  our traffic jam is one for the books.  we often joke you can cook rice in the midst of traffic and eat it too. 

2) we are a left hand drive country.  take care crossing streets. 

3) bring an umbrella or a cap to shield you from the sun or some torrential rain showers or drizzles.  

4) always have your belongings within your sight and that you’re actually holding them.  i say this with love.  

5) enjoy!  be loud and proud in the concert.  sing a long if you know the lyrics.  we love the karaoke type of vibe.  

✌️ Hope to see you there!
